'''Callen Troyt''' was a member of the [[Dagger Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Dagger Squadron]]. He was the gold Dagger and an experienced [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He and the Daggers were going to be ordered by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] to go to [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]], but the order was never given. He participated in the squadron's assault on [[Bannistar Station]].
